en: Color postcard view of a historic hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral featuring two tall spires and several smaller spires, attached to an extensive castle-like ensemble with red-tiled roofs and a round tower. The buildings rise above a riverside town of smaller houses and warehouses, with barges and boats moored on a broad river in the foreground under a clear blue sky. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
